_comment: BKS26 Volunteer Coordinator — Claude Code project settings. C2: Memory Management via PreCompact and Stop hooks saving coordinator state to sessions/. No PostToolUse linters needed for this non-code project.

PreCompact.purpose: Before context compaction, save current coordinator session state (sign-in/out log, open incidents, hours tracker) to .claude/sessions/ so it survives the compaction window.

Stop.purpose: On session end, persist a session diary entry to .claude/sessions/ capturing coordinator state. Next shift loads this file for cross-shift continuity.

_architecture_notes.C2: PreCompact and Stop hooks implement the session diary pattern from the-longform-guide.md. Each hook writes a .tmp file to .claude/sessions/. The coordinator reads the most recent .tmp at shift start.
_architecture_notes.no_PostToolUse_linters: This project has no code to lint. PostToolUse hooks are not configured — they would add latency with no benefit for a knowledge/coordination workload.
